lead: Every course at Bildungsforum Marnau belongs to one of these six areas. Each area page lists the dates for all four houses, so you only have to choose the subject, not the town.

items.title: Languages
items.description: Twenty-two languages from A1 to C1, plus the conversation evenings that ask for no certificate at all.

items.title: Digital skills
items.description: From a first email account to spreadsheets, accounting software and online banking you can trust yourself with.

items.title: Business and accounting
items.description: Bookkeeping, payroll and the commercial examination the trade licence asks for, in the evening or over four Saturdays.

items.title: Health and care
items.description: Care assistance, first aid for workplaces and the refresher hours the care register expects every two years.

items.title: Trades and technology
items.description: Welding tickets, the annual electrical safety check and the machine courses that run in the Steintal workshop.

items.title: Basic education
items.description: Reading, writing and arithmetic for adults, and the school-leaving certificate in four terms without a fee.
